basic_info.description: Soaring ceilings and classic period charm define this sun-drenched top-floor Victorian flat, situated in a stately two-unit building with a stunning, beautifully preserved facade. This bright and airy 2-bedroom home showcases its heritage with original crown molding, refurbished Douglas fir wood floors, large windows and gracious proportions that reflect its timeless character. The updated kitchen with gleaming new countertops opens seamlessly into the dining area and out onto a spacious private deck perfect for entertaining or enjoying meals al fresco. Whether you're hosting friends or savoring a quiet morning coffee, the indoor-outdoor flow creates a truly special experience. Additional highlights include one-car deeded parking, shared laundry area and a large private storage unit. A lush, shared backyard offers even more outdoor space to relax or unwind. Just a short stroll to the vibrant shops and restaurants along Divisadero Street and minutes from iconic Alamo Square, this home offers the ideal blend of classic San Francisco architecture and modern-day comfort in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods!
